title: Broaden the 4.4 measures to effective use, sustainability and outcomes
requirements:
- Include patient and workforce experience, safety, equity and trust, disaggregated
- Add measures of equitable access and successful use (task completion, assisted access)
- Add indicators for running cost and domestic share of financing
- Consider pragmatic measures of whether receivers act appropriately on exchanged information
- Add routine-use measures that show a platform is institutionalised
- Add continuity indicators (designated holders, tested transfer plans, recurrent funding)
- Consider referral/follow-up completion as a coordination indicator
- Distinguish model, deployed, conformant, operational and effective-use coverage
